description: Get one Magic Reach recipient bucket for a managed community. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

bucketName.description: Canonical Magic Reach bucket identifier from the `bucket` field returned by list_magic_reach_buckets; do not use `name` or `displayName`.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

name: get_magic_reach_bucket
title: Get Magic Reach Bucket
